title: Key-Value Store Schema for AI-Ready Documentation Crawler
description: The schema defines how the Actor stores its outputs in the Key-Value Store.

crawlStatistics.title: Crawl Statistics
crawlStatistics.description: Aggregated data about page counts, sizes, and crawl performance.

jsonSchema.title: Crawl Statistics
jsonSchema.description: Summary of data collected and processed during the crawl.

totalPagesCrawled.description: The total number of pages successfully crawled.

failedRequests.description: The number of failed requests during the crawl.

scrapingDuration.description: How long the Actor spent scraping data (in seconds).

averageContentSize.description: The average size of the scraped content (in bytes).

documentationExport.title: Documentation Export
documentationExport.description: A downloadable export of all the crawled documentation pages.

jsonSchema.title: Documentation Export
jsonSchema.description: Export of documentation content, optimized for fine-tuning LLMs.

url.description: URL where the page was scraped from.
